items.name: primary-button
items.title: Primary Button
items.description: The default call-to-action button, solid fill with a hover and focus state.

items.name: ghost-button
items.title: Ghost Button
items.description: A lower-emphasis outline button for secondary actions.

items.name: toggle-switch
items.title: Toggle Switch
items.description: An accessible on/off switch built on a native button with role="switch".

items.name: text-field
items.title: Text Field
items.description: A labeled text input with clear focus and placeholder states.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: A square icon-only button with a spring-in tooltip and a tap wiggle.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A custom listbox with a sliding highlight and staggered option entrance, built on real ARIA combobox semantics.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: An accessible checkbox with a spring-drawn checkmark and a small tick-particle burst on check.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A range input with a value-reactive gradient fill, a color-matched thumb glow, and a tooltip that appears while dragging.

items.name: intent-aware-button
items.title: Intent-Aware Button
items.description: A delete button that reads hesitation instead of just clicks: genuinely tracked cursor proximity, not a mock. Pause over it and a warning line expands in; drift toward it and back twice and it escalates to 'Are you sure?'; only a real press-and-hold, with an animated fill, commits the destructive action.

items.name: document-upload
items.title: Document Upload
items.description: A drag-and-drop dropzone backed by a real native file input, in single- or multiple-file mode via the `multiple` prop; a genuine sonar-pulse checkmark confirms every add, files get a type-aware icon (the same emerald/amber split Attachments uses), and each one lists with a delete button to remove it before it's used.

items.name: share-card
items.title: Share Card
items.description: The unfurled preview card a recipient sees when a shared Claude or ChatGPT conversation link lands somewhere else: a platform badge, title, fade-clamped snippet, and message count, with a spring pop-in and lift on hover.

items.name: share-sheet
items.title: Share Sheet
items.description: The dialog that produces that card: a sliding Only you / Anyone with the link toggle reveals a real clipboard-copy link row (the button icon morphs link-to-check) and a live preview of the resulting share card, so the two pieces are shown as one flow.

items.name: hover-border-gradient
items.title: Hover Border Gradient
items.description: A button ringed by a rotating conic-gradient comet that speeds up on hover or focus.

items.name: notification-button
items.title: Notification Button
items.description: An icon button ringed by the hover-gradient comet; click to open a notification list with a spring-in unread count badge.

items.name: moving-border-button
items.title: Moving Border Button
items.description: A single bright gradient segment travels the button's own rounded-rect perimeter, measured live so it fits any size.

items.name: content-card
items.title: Content Card
items.description: A clickable card for articles or case studies, with a lift-on-hover affordance.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: A compact metric display with a label, value, and optional delta.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small status pill with neutral, success, and warning tones.

items.name: pricing-card
items.title: Pricing Card
items.description: A plan card with a count-up price, a shine-swept 'popular' ribbon, and a staggered feature list.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group
items.description: An overlapping avatar stack that fans out on hover and pops a spring-in name/role tooltip; hovering the '+N' overflow indicator lists everyone it's hiding.

items.name: wave-card
items.title: Wave Card
items.description: A full-bleed teal card with an animated SVG turbulence filter tracing a caustic light net across the surface, like sunlight refracting through shallow water.

items.name: glow-card
items.title: Glow Card
items.description: A card with a large blurred gradient blob drifting slowly behind it: ambient, not cursor-tracked like Spotlight Card.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: An expandable panel with an animated height, a rotating plus-to-cross icon, and real ARIA region semantics.

items.name: testimonial-card
items.title: Testimonial Card
items.description: A quote card whose quotation-mark watermark drifts slightly with the cursor, like a subtler SpotlightCard.

items.name: swipe-cards
items.title: Swipe Cards
items.description: A Tinder-style card stack: drag left or right to skip or save, with a tilting card, color-coded SAVE/SKIP stamps, and arrow keys as a non-drag alternative.

items.name: link-preview-card
items.title: Link Preview Card
items.description: A rich unfurl card for hyperlinking to anything with a UI or an image, like pasting a link into Slack or Notion: a mocked screenshot thumbnail by default, a real `image` (plus an optional `credit`) for an actual photo with a click-through attribution chip, or a `liveUrl` to embed the real destination page itself, scaled down, as a genuinely live thumbnail rather than a static shot. The thumbnail zooms slightly on hover, an external-link icon fades in over the domain, and the card resolves through a real shimmering skeleton first, timed to the iframe's own `onLoad` event when `liveUrl` is used, so the loading state reflects an actual fetch.

items.name: pill-tabs
items.title: Pill Tabs
items.description: A segmented tab control with a sliding active state.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: A simple breadcrumb trail with an aria-current page marker.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: A ⌘K search overlay with grouped fuzzy results, arrow-key navigation, and a sliding highlight; this very page uses it to jump between sections.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: A numbered page control with a sliding active-page highlight, the same layoutId technique as Pill Tabs.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A multi-step progress indicator whose connecting lines fill and whose completed steps draw in a checkmark.

items.name: icon-stepper
items.title: Icon Stepper
items.description: A stepper with a swappable per-step icon instead of a number: the demo's own icon set swap button proves it, live.

items.name: comet-stepper
items.title: Comet Stepper
items.description: Advancing sends a glowing comet racing along the connector, the arriving step bursts with a ring pulse, and every badge face-swaps with a 3D flip; multi-step jumps cascade left to right.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A click-triggered menu with a spring-in panel, sliding hover highlight, and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: dock-nav
items.title: Dock Nav
items.description: A floating, physics-magnified dock in the shape of macOS's own: icons grow the closer your cursor gets to them, tracked per-icon off a single shared pointer position, and pop upward as they magnify. Scroll the panel and it tucks itself out of view, then springs back the moment you scroll up, the same behavior you'd get pinning it `fixed` to the bottom of a real page.

items.name: rail-nav
items.title: Rail Nav
items.description: A top nav bar that collapses to its mobile menu off its own measured width via ResizeObserver, not a CSS breakpoint: nest it in a sidebar and it still gets it right. A shared sliding pill tracks whichever link is hovered, hovering "Product" or "Solutions" drops a live mega-panel of preview tiles beneath the bar, and a soft glow trails the pointer along the top edge. Switch the frame to "Mobile" to see the same component fall back to a slide-down menu.

items.name: sidebar-nav
items.title: Sidebar Nav
items.description: The left app-shell sidebar most SaaS dashboards actually ship (Linear, Notion, Vercel): drag its right edge to resize it, or drag past the collapse point and it snaps into a 64px icon-only rail, the same click-the-hamburger toggle works too, with labels shrinking away in place and a hover tooltip standing in for them. A real workspace switcher and search sit up top, grouped links carry a sliding active highlight, a badge count becomes a small dot once collapsed, and the footer is a working presence switcher (Online/Away/Do not disturb/Offline) instead of a static profile card. Switch the frame to "Mobile" to see the same hamburger button open a slide-in drawer over a backdrop instead of collapsing in place.

items.name: reveal-on-scroll
items.title: Reveal on Scroll
items.description: Fades and lifts content in the first time it enters the viewport.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: An infinitely looping horizontal scroller built on a Framer Motion animate loop.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: A card with a radial glow that follows the cursor, bound via a motion value.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Magnetic Button
items.description: A button that pulls toward the cursor within a radius on two independently-sprung layers, then snaps back on leave.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A hover/focus tooltip that springs in and flips from top to bottom automatically near the edge of its container.

items.name: infinite-moving-cards
items.title: Infinite Moving Cards
items.description: Like Marquee, but scrolling full testimonial cards in two independently-directed, pause-on-hover rows.

items.name: text-generate-effect
items.title: Text Generate Effect
items.description: Words sharpen into focus one at a time as the paragraph enters the viewport, blur-to-sharp rather than a plain fade.

items.name: orbit-loader
items.title: Orbit Loader
items.description: Two dots orbit a swappable center icon; pass your own product's mark via the icon prop.

items.name: pulse-loader
items.title: Pulse Loader
items.description: A sonar-pulse loading indicator; pass your own product's mark via the icon prop.

items.name: thinking-loader
items.title: Thinking Loader
items.description: A spinning icon beside a word that cycles through a swappable list ("Thinking", "Finagling"...) with a trailing pulsing ellipsis, in the spirit of Claude Code's own status line; both the icon and the word list are optional props.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: An empty-state panel with a floating inbox icon, breathing waiting rings, and an optional action.

items.name: success-state
items.title: Success State
items.description: A confirmation panel with a spring-in checkmark, a confirm ring burst, and a particle scatter.

items.name: error-state
items.title: Error State
items.description: An error panel with a shake animation and an urgency-pulsed halo.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A corner notification with a draining progress bar and drag-to-dismiss; swipe it away or let it time out.

items.name: skeleton-loader
items.title: Skeleton Loader
items.description: A shimmer-swept placeholder card for loading states, with a static reduced-motion fallback.

items.name: chat-input-bar
items.title: Chat Input Bar
items.description: An AI-chat composer with an always-on ambient glow: real permission-gated mic recording with playback, attach and new-conversation icons, a model-picker dropdown, and a send button that morphs into a stoppable 'thinking' state.

items.name: chain-of-thought
items.title: Chain of Thought
items.description: A live agent reasoning trace: a hand-drawn connector line fills as each step resolves, a real elapsed-time counter ticks while it works, and it auto-collapses into a 'Thought for 2.8s' summary pill once done; replay it any time.

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: Raw model reasoning streaming word-by-word into an auto-scrolling, fade-masked panel with a blinking cursor; collapses into a duration pill when finished, just like extended thinking in Claude or ChatGPT.

items.name: confirmation
items.title: Confirmation
items.description: An inline tool-call approval card with a risk-tiered badge; destructive actions require a genuine press-and-hold to approve (the fill animates as you hold and snaps back if you let go early), so nothing catastrophic fires from a stray click.

items.name: sources
items.title: Sources
items.description: Perplexity-style citations: numbered inline markers and their source cards highlight each other bidirectionally on hover or focus, collapsed by default behind a fanned favicon stack.

items.name: suggestion
items.title: Suggestion
items.description: A row of quick-reply chips with a fade-masked scroll edge; picking one flies it into a composer-preview pill instead of just vanishing, and a shuffle button swaps in a fresh batch with a staggered spring.

items.name: tool
items.title: Tool
items.description: A tool-call card whose status pill smoothly morphs pending → running → success/error with a live duration counter; try both outcomes with the demo's own toggle.

items.name: artifact
items.title: Artifact
items.description: A generated-file panel that shimmers in like it's being written, keeps a real version history you can scrub between, and expands into a true fullscreen modal via a shared-layout morph; copy and download both actually work.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A multi-file, tabbed code snippet with its own lightweight hand-rolled tokenizer (no highlighter dependency), line numbers, and a copy button; lines stream in staggered on every tab switch.

items.name: commit
items.title: Commit
items.description: An agent-authored commit message streams in word by word, then the hash (genuinely derived from the message text via a small hash function, not hardcoded), and file stats pop in, with an expandable per-file diff summary.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree
items.description: A changed-files tree that builds itself in with a staggered cascade, like the agent is scaffolding it live; new/modified/deleted status is signaled by icon, label, and strikethrough, never color alone.

items.name: sandbox
items.title: Sandbox
items.description: A container boot sequence that settles into a live 'Ready' state with a copyable preview URL and breathing CPU/memory gauges; restart it to watch the boot steps resolve again.

items.name: test-results
items.title: Test Results
items.description: A test suite runs sequentially with a live segmented pass/fail progress bar and a real elapsed-time counter; the one failing test expands in place to show its assertion message.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: Commands the agent runs get typed in character by character and their output streams line by line, auto-scrolling as it goes; settles into a blinking idle cursor once the sequence finishes.

items.name: audio-player
items.title: Audio Player
items.description: A voice-reply player backed by a real audio file: a genuinely click-and-drag-to-seek waveform (full keyboard support too, arrow keys, Home/End, Space), a mute toggle with a slim volume slider, a playback-speed cycle button, and controls to swap in your own audio file or delete it entirely.

items.name: audio-scrubber
items.title: Audio Scrubber
items.description: The same real-audio voice-reply player (swap-in/delete audio included), but the seek control is a Spotify-style progress rail: a slim track that thickens on hover and reveals a circular thumb, instead of a bar-height waveform.

items.name: persona
items.title: Persona
items.description: An AI agent identity card with an abstract gradient 'orb' avatar instead of a human avatar; switching between personas briefly flashes a 'Thinking' status before crossfading to the new persona's traits.

items.name: transcription
items.title: Transcription
items.description: Live speech-to-text with a real interim/final distinction: press record and it transcribes what you actually say via the browser's Speech Recognition API, with words streaming in muted and italic while still being recognized, then settling into solid text once that phrase finalizes. Includes a language selector.

items.name: voice-selector
items.title: Voice Selector
items.description: A voice picker where auditioning a voice and selecting it are two separate actions, like real TTS pickers; each option gets its own preview button with a pulsing ring while it 'plays', independent of which voice is actually selected.

items.name: attachments
items.title: Attachments
items.description: A file tray with a real native file picker: files you actually add get their real name and size and start 'uploading' with a per-item circular progress ring; one demo file fails on purpose so you can see the retry flow.

items.name: settings-panel
items.title: Settings Panel
items.description: The two-pane settings dialog every AI chat app converges on, in the mold of Claude's and ChatGPT's own: a live sidebar search, a grouped sliding-highlight tab list, and an Accent color picker that actually retints every focus ring, button, and toggle in the dialog the instant you pick a new one, not just its own swatch. Every field genuinely autosaves (switch tabs or close and reopen the dialog and nothing resets) with a real 'Saving… / Saved' indicator, not a decorative one. A dismissible MFA banner morphs into a real confirmation on click, and the Profile pane's avatar recolors on click too.

items.name: app-widget
items.title: App Widget
items.description: The rich, app-branded result card a connected tool hands back inline in chat: the same pattern ChatGPT's and Claude's app/MCP connectors use to render real UI instead of plain text. Every instance opens gated behind a real "Sign in to {app}" step: with an `app.loginUrl` set, clicking it genuinely opens that product's real login page in a new tab (Spotify's and Figma's own, here) before spring-morphing into a "Connecting…" spinner and the live result, and that connection genuinely persists across visits (`localStorage`, a rolling 30-day expiry), so it only re-gates after a month of disuse rather than every reload. In `mode="live"` the result is the product's own official iframe (demoed here with Spotify's and Figma's real, live embeds, not a recreation), resolving from a genuine shimmering skeleton via the iframe's own `onLoad`. For apps with no embeddable surface, the default demo mode renders a hand-built card instead, generalized past music with a `resultKind` prop, "audio" (Preview/Pause, a live equalizer) or "document" (Open/Opened, a checkmark badge), plus real thumbs and a header action (a Devices menu or a Copy-link button that morphs to a checkmark), picked per instance.

items.name: all
items.title: All components
items.description: Every component and variant in the library (74 total), installed at once.
